channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jared Dudley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jared Dudley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Paul George on Jared Dudley
item.description:
Andrew Greif:Paul George:

“God bless you Jared Dudley. I don't know what it is, dudes love throwing my name in stuff. But God bless you, Jared.”

Paul George on Jared Dudley, Feb 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @AndrewGreif.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Jared Dudley, Alex Caruso
item.description:
Davis said, referring to Caldwell-Pope.

“Wes is still struggling to find his consistent 3.He's been getting open looks, but I still put Wes up there. I put Bron third, just because of this year he's been able to shoot the ball extremely well. Marc [Gasol] can shoot it. Marc is up there. And then I put myself. Dudz [Jared Dudley]. AC [Alex Caruso].”

Anthony Davis on Jared Dudley, Alex Caruso, Jan 16, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Jared Dudley
item.description:
Mark Medina:Lakers forward Anthony Davis on Jared Dudley expecting him to go for the MVP this season:

“He has a lot of high expectations for me. I have a lot of high expectations for myself.”

Anthony Davis on Jared Dudley, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Jared Dudley
item.description:
*@Alex Caruso on @Jared Dudley:

“Being a professional, being a great teammate, being the veteran that he is … he’s been great for us. Great person, great teammate, fun guy to be around. He makes everybody feel welcome.”

Alex Caruso on Jared Dudley, Sep 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Jared Dudley
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma on Jared Dudley mentoring him:

“He's a great guy to get advice from, always there to lend a hand.”

Kyle Kuzma on Jared Dudley, Jul 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @hmfaigen.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jared Dudley
item.description:
Now that the Portland Trail Blazers have added the 17-year veteran and 10-time All-Star, Anthony can now weigh in on how Dudley became linked to his hiatus from the league.

“Me and Jared Dudley had some issues in the past, man, but I started feeling bad for him a little bit,”

Carmelo Anthony on Jared Dudley, Nov 22, 2019. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Jared Dudley
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Joel Embiid on Jared Dudley:

“First of all, he’s a nobody. When opponents do stuff like that, they’re trying to get us out of our game. I’m too valuable for that.”

Joel Embiid on Jared Dudley, Apr 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Impact Basketball on Jared Dudley, Alan Anderson, Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
One Impact staffer explained why the underdog squad was so good:

“Alan Anderson was pissed off that he wasn’t in the NBA yet, so he would score lights out and always played with a chip on his shoulder. He wanted to show he belonged. Ty Lue ran the pick-and-roll to perfection. Jared Dudley always made the smart play and was shooting really well. Tayshaun Prince was probably their best all-around player. Overall, they were a really smart team; their basketball IQ was excellent. Even though it was a pick-up game, they played excellent help-side defense. They would double-team and frustrate the other team so much. For a while, they couldn’t lose.”

Impact Basketball on Jared Dudley, Alan Anderson, Tayshaun Prince, Aug 7, 2017. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on Jared Dudley
item.description:
“I was telling Dudley to relax, like, calm down, because you’re not that type of guy,”

Brandon Jennings on Jared Dudley, Mar 8, 2017. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: John Wall on Paul Pierce, Jared Dudley, Gary Neal, Alan Anderson
item.description:
John Wall:

“It was great. It was tough losing Paul [Pierce], Rasual [Butler] and those guys because they helped us a lot, but I like the additions. Alan [Anderson] can help us. Gary [Neal] has been around a team that’s been to the Finals. A guy like Jared Dudley knows what it takes to win and he’s someone who knows his role. These are all veteran guys who know their role and who can come in and just help us win games. Those kind of guys are key.”

John Wall on Paul Pierce, Jared Dudley, Gary Neal, Alan Anderson, Oct 1, 2015. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Chris Paul on Jared Dudley
item.description:
“I was actually shooting a commercial at USC when I found out we got J.J. and Jared Dudley. Doc (Rivers) has been amazing since he got the head coaching job, and it’s been pretty fun to sit back and see the different guys we’ve brought to our team.”

Chris Paul on Jared Dudley, Aug 9, 2013. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Darren Collison, Jared Dudley, JJ Redick, DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“Well, Chris is going to be a Hall of Famer, and so should Blake (Griffin) and DJ (DeAndre Jordan), hopefully, but we were getting (surefire future Hall of Famers). Paul was and Ray and Kevin are, so in that terms, that day is bigger just because of those three guys. You just don't bring those three guys together very often. This was neater in one way in that it was more about the key guys, signing Chris back, bringing Matt back, and getting Darren Collison and JJ Redick and Jared Dudley, it's more that we're building this team, and that was a great message … I couldn't have asked for a better day.”

Doc Rivers on Darren Collison, Jared Dudley, JJ Redick, DeAndre Jordan, Jul 12, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Jared Dudley, Robin Lopez, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“We have to continue to get improvement out of our young players like Markieff (Morris). I think Jared Dudley has made improvements. We have to get Robin (Lopez) to the point where he's consistently playing (well). I don't think we're a championship team. But I definitely think with the addition of a couple of guys here and there in free agency, we can get back in the mix and be a factor, for sure.”

Alvin Gentry on Jared Dudley, Robin Lopez, Markieff Morris, May 31, 2012. Source: Arizona Republic.
